name: 30512 · Blairsville, GA
findings: ZIP 30512 (Blairsville) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30512 (Blairsville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30512 (Blairsville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
